spec.headline_rationale: Lone Wolf's operations lead owns systems, process, measurement and AI adoption. Use current master integrations, training, data architecture and AI marketing projects without inventing HubSpot certifications or specific HubSpot admin accomplishments.

Installed and integrated Go High Level with ServiceTitan, Power BI and internal systems, and trained employees on its use. Created automated reporting across more than ten marketing channels and standardized agency account-management processes. Cross-functional leadership, ERP information architecture and AI-assisted marketing development provide practical depth for improving workflows, explaining technical decisions and connecting marketing activity with reliable performance information.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Lone Wolf Marketing Operations Lead posting. Any Hour integration/training, E009/E081/E060/E066 and current AI project facts support summary. HubSpot tool knowledge supported but specific advanced HubSpot administration, scoring architecture and certification not established; no real-estate SaaS tenure invented.
